summary: CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp., an indirect wholly owned unit of CenterPoint Energy Inc., closed the sale of all equity interests in Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio, LLC (VEDO) to National Fuel Gas Company for $2.62 billion, subject to adjustment, under an October 20, 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement. Consideration comprises $1.42 billion cash paid at the October 1, 2026 closing plus remaining components. The sale divests the Ohio gas utility franchise. What to watch: purchase-price adjustment mechanics, regulatory approvals already cleared, and use of proceeds for deleveraging or capital plans.
